# @boostengine/ui

> Universal, zero-config, industry-standard React & Next.js UI component kit.
> Live component playground: https://boostengine001.github.io/packages/
> Built for High-Converting eCommerce, Modern SaaS, Enterprise Admin Dashboards, and Marketing Landing Pages.
> Zero external CSS dependencies. AI Coding Agent Native (Cursor, Claude, Windsurf, Copilot, Gemini).

## Overview
- **Package**: `@boostengine/ui`
- **Version**: `2.1.6`
- **Supported Frameworks**: Next.js (App Router & Pages Router), React 18 & 19, Vite, Remix
- **CSS Dependencies**: Zero. All components use built-in inline styles and CSS variable hooks.
- **Client Directives**: Pre-configured with `'use client'` for Next.js App Router.
- **Theming & Presets**: Integrated `BoostProvider` with 7 design presets (`minimal`, `glassmorphism`, `neumorphism`, `neo-brutalism`, `dark-first`, `gradient-glow`, `material-you`), dynamic `PresetSwitcher` component, and 1-line dark/light mode toggle.
- **Components**: 125+ production-ready components across 12 categories.
- **Hooks**: 14 SSR-safe utility hooks (useBoostPreset, useFocusTrap, useAnnounce, useMediaQuery, useDebounce, useLocalStorage, useForm, etc.)
- **Utils**: 18 utility functions (cn, formatCurrency, formatDate, slugify, validators, etc.)
- **Subpaths**: `@boostengine/ui`, `@boostengine/ui/hooks`, `@boostengine/ui/utils`

## Quick Start
```tsx
import { BoostProvider, ToastProvider, Button, HeroSection, PresetSwitcher } from '@boostengine/ui';

export default function App() {
  return (
    <BoostProvider defaultPreset="neo-brutalism" defaultMode="system">
      <ToastProvider position="bottom-right">
        <PresetSwitcher variant="floating" position="bottom-right" />
        <HeroSection
          badge="🚀 Powered by Boost Engine"
          title="Build Stunning Apps in Minutes"
          description="Universal, production-ready component suite for high-velocity teams."
          primaryAction={{ label: 'Get Started', onClick: () => alert('Welcome!') }}
        />
      </ToastProvider>
    </BoostProvider>
  );
}
```

- **Theming & Presets**: `BoostProvider`, `useBoostPreset`, `useTheme`, `ThemeToggle`, `PresetSwitcher`
- **Primitives**: `Box`, `Flex`, `Stack`, `VStack`, `HStack`, `Grid`, `GridItem`, `Section`, `AspectRatio`, `ScrollArea`, `Container`, `PageWrapper`, `Motion`, `Divider`
- **Buttons & Actions**: `Button`, `IconButton`, `ButtonGroup`, `FloatingActionButton`, `LinkButton`, `CopyButton`
- **Forms & Inputs**: `Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `MultiSelect`, `Checkbox`, `Radio`, `RadioGroup`, `Switch`, `DatePicker`, `TimePicker`, `FileUpload`, `FileDropzone`, `SearchInput`, `FormField`, `OTPInput`
- **Feedback & Status**: `Toast`, `ToastProvider`, `useToast`, `Loader`, `Spinner`, `ProgressBar`, `Skeleton`, `Alert`, `Snackbar`, `EmptyState`, `ErrorState`, `SuccessMessage`
- **Content & Display**: `Card`, `CardHeader`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `CardContent`, `CardFooter`, `Image`, `Avatar`, `AvatarGroup`, `Badge`, `Tag`, `Tooltip`, `Chip`, `Divider`, `Accordion`, `Carousel`
- **Overlays & Dialogs**: `Modal`, `Dialog`, `Drawer`, `BottomSheet`, `Popover`, `ConfirmationDialog`, `CommandPalette`, `Portal`
- **Navigation & Layout**: `Header`, `Navbar`, `Sidebar`, `Footer`, `MobileBottomBar`, `MobileBottomNav`, `Breadcrumb`, `NavLink`, `DropdownMenu`, `MegaMenu`, `Pagination`, `Tabs`, `Stepper`, `BackButton`
- **Data & Analytics & Charts**: `AreaChart`, `BarChart`, `DonutChart`, `Sparkline`, `Table`, `DataTable`, `StatsCard`, `KPIWidget`, `ActivityFeed`, `NotificationCenter`, `DateRangePicker`, `ExportButton`, `Filter`, `Sort`
- **Authentication**: `LoginForm` (inline validated), `RegisterForm` (inline validated), `ForgotPassword`, `ResetPassword`
- **eCommerce & Storefront**: `CartDrawer`, `StickyAddToCart`, `PincodeChecker`, `TrustBadges`, `OrderTimeline`, `StarRating`, `ProductGallery`, `VariantSelector`, `ProductCard`, `QuantitySelector`, `ReviewBreakdownBars`, `AnnouncementBar`, `LightningDealsBar`, `FrequentlyBoughtTogether`, `BankOffersAccordion`, `AssuredBadge`, `DualMobileActionBar`, `Price`, `AddToCart`, `CouponInput`, `AddressForm` (inline validated), `OrderSummary`
- **Marketing & Landing**: `HeroSection`, `FeatureGrid`, `PricingTable`, `TestimonialCard`, `TestimonialGrid`, `FAQSection`, `LogoCloud`, `CTASection`

## Utility Hooks (SSR-safe)
```tsx
import {
  useMediaQuery,       // Reactive CSS media query
  useClickOutside,     // Click-outside detection
  useDebounce,         // Delayed state updates
  useLocalStorage,     // Persistent state in localStorage
  useWindowSize,       // Reactive window dimensions
  useScrollPosition,   // Reactive scroll Y/X
  usePrevious,         // Previous value tracking
  useCopyToClipboard,  // Clipboard write with copy state
  useToggle,           // Boolean toggle helper
  useIntersectionObserver, // Viewport visibility detection
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect, // SSR-safe layout effect
  useForm,             // Zero-dependency form state & validation
} from '@boostengine/ui';
// Or via subpath:
// import { useForm, useDebounce } from '@boostengine/ui/hooks';
```

## Utility Functions
```tsx
import {
  cn,                    // Class merging (like clsx, no dependencies)
  formatCurrency,        // Locale-aware currency (default: INR)
  formatNumber,          // Locale-aware number formatting
  formatDate,            // Human-readable date formatting
  formatRelativeTime,    // Relative time ('2 minutes ago')
  truncate,              // String truncation with ellipsis
  slugify,               // URL-safe slug generation
  generateId,            // Random alphanumeric ID
  clamp,                 // Number range clamping
  groupBy,               // Array grouping by key
  deepMerge,             // Recursive object merge
  omit,                  // Object key exclusion
  pick,                  // Object key selection
  debounce,              // Function debouncing
  getInitials,           // Name initials extraction
  isValidEmail,          // Email format validation
  isValidIndianPincode,  // Indian postal code validation
  isValidIndianMobile    // Indian mobile number validation
} from '@boostengine/ui';
```

## Prop Naming Conventions (Zero Hallucination Guide)
- **Open state**: `isOpen` (NOT `open`, `show`, `visible`)
- **Loading state**: `isLoading` or `loading`
- **Disabled**: `disabled`
- **Close handler**: `onClose`
- **Select handler**: `onSelect`
- **Submit handler**: `onSubmit`
- **Variants**: `'primary' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'destructive'`
- **Sizes**: `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'`
- **Action objects**: `{ label: string, onClick?: () => void, href?: string }`
- **Brand name**: `brandName`

## CLI Tooling
```bash
# List all available components
npx @boostengine/ui list

# Scaffold component source directly into your app (Shadcn-style)
npx @boostengine/ui add hero-section
npx @boostengine/ui add cart-drawer
npx @boostengine/ui add pricing-table

# Initialize config file in project root
npx @boostengine/ui init
```

## CSS Variable Reference
All BoostProvider tokens:
- `--boost-primary` — Primary brand color
- `--boost-primary-hover` — Primary hover state
- `--boost-bg` — Page background
- `--boost-surface` — Card/panel surface
- `--boost-text` — Body text
- `--boost-text-muted` — Muted secondary text
- `--boost-border` — Border color
- `--boost-radius` — Border radius
- `--boost-font` — Font family stack
